aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the dry-time defect rows but misstates the changed factor and invents an unsupported measurement outcome.
issues: Changed factor should be dry duration versus normal 16s reference, not unspecified test condition.
10 min condition is omitted from changed-factor grouping.
Baseline/test relationship is ambiguous because normal 16s has no result row.
Measurement outcome is derived from headers, not gauss values.
Gauss table labels cite no numeric before/after results.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Normal Dry 16s be treated only as a reference or as the baseline?
Are gauss values available in hidden/image content not extracted here?
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as UV yoke sealing dry time: 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10 min with Normal Dry 16s reference.
Include all five dry-time conditions under one process-condition review case.
Keep function defect outcome using rows 14,16,18,20,22 with input, OK, NG, and rate.
Remove the unsupported measurement outcome unless numeric gauss rows are provided.
Mark judgement not_judged or needs_review due small n and missing normal baseline result.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are sufficient for defect counts only; measurement and baseline evidence are insufficient.
